tldr: US stocks closed July at RECORD highs on a two-day AI-capex relief rally — S&P 7,489.72, Dow's 4th straight winning month — but the 10Y hit a one-year-high 4.73% and markets price ~53-61% odds of a September Fed hike: the core risk to the book (levered silver, SGX REITs, HK tech) is the rate side, not the equity side.

The book's core held firm: gold ~$4,080 near a record, silver ~$57-59 — the steadier hedge into the reignited Iran conflict and sticky 3.3% core PCE. Favor gold-heavy GDX over pure silver leverage while a one-year-high real-rate channel is a two-sided pull.
